title: Cozumel beach pass booked: does it include your taxi?
description: Before your Cozumel cruise beach day, check whether the pass includes transport. If it does not, add outward and return taxi quotes for every vehicle to the admission total. Read the guide's inclusion checks and use the free group-cost calculator with your own quotes; it is not a live fare lookup. description: One Cozumel beach stop or several island stops? Compare two taxi rides with reserved driver time for the same party and route. Check included hours, admissions, waiting and return arrangements, then enter complete quotes in the free calculator. No live fare or savings guarantee. title: Costa Maya port or Mahahual? Choose your cruise-day setting
description: Stay in the Costa Maya port complex for simpler transport, or go to Mahahual for the beachfront town? Compare atmosphere, mobility, weather fallback and the taxi each way before choosing. Archival photos: port entrance, Larry D. Moore, CC BY 4.0; Mahahual malecon, Juan Ortega, CC BY 3.0. title: Mahahual beach day from Costa Maya: plan your return first
description: Before leaving Costa Maya port for Mahahual, subtract the pier walk and your return allowance from usable time ashore. Budget both taxi rides plus any beach minimum spend or day pass, and set a leave-the-beach alarm. The comparison guide helps decide if staying in port fits better.
